inputs.target_skill_path: Required target skill root path. It must point at the skill directory that directly contains SKILL.md and assets/so-workflow/.
inputs.goal: Required deterministic skill creation or upgrade goal.
inputs.requested_target_skill_changes: Required description of target-skill files/contracts/assets to create or modify. This is the primary business-outcome contract.
inputs.expression_binding: Machine-readable root expression contract for workflow generation: language, languageVersion, contractId, contractVersion, requiredExpressionCapabilities, compileFeedbackContract, and allowed expression forms. Current supported language is csharp only.
inputs.gate_failure_guidance_contract: Hard workflow-generation contract: every validation gate must include failureGuidance with a concrete nextAction and evidenceReferences. Each evidence reference must use a target-relative path, verified 1-based startLine/endLine, and an exact source quote that tells the next agent how to repair the failed gate. The workflow designer must self-review every gate before returning success.
inputs.channel: Derived package channel for the enhancement pass. Infer released versus beta from the checked-in SO package lock and the bound skill package version when needed; do not ask the user to choose a channel during normal SO enhancement runs.
inputs.context_file: Optional path to a JSON context file.
inputs.workspace_root: Optional existing workspace directory outside the target skill root. When supplied, verified Mermaid and HTML artifacts are mirrored below the workspace for clickable links.
inputs.reference_pack_manifest: Required bounded reference manifest for workflow design. It must use schemaVersion workflow-designer.reference-manifest.v1; entries require path, sha256, runtimeVersion, authorityRole, readStatus, and validationResult; and the exact-runtime guide/schema/demo/demo-audit entries must share one generationSetId.
inputs.schema_demo_input: Required fresh exact-runtime schemaDemoInput descriptor containing runtime=so, runtimeBinding=dotnet-so, runtimeVersion, schemaFile, demoFile, demoCompileAudit, schemaSha256, and demoSha256. Both files must parse, share the reference-manifest generationSetId, and the same-runtime demo compile must succeed.
inputs.previous_runnable_reference: Optional previous workflow reference. It is readable only as previous_runnable_reference evidence. When supplied, its disposition must include source_version, source_path, source_hash, copy_time, reusable_shapes, differences_from_current_schema_and_requirements, and rejected_or_deprecated_items.
inputs.workflow_design_output_root: Runtime-owned output root for workflow-design/reference-manifest.json, static-contract-review.json, and semantic-probe-report.json. It must remain outside the static skill bundle.

default_assumptions.package_index_source: The source of truth for acquiring the Loom Skill Orchestrator package is the absolute URL of the released or beta package index page that matches the bound runtime version. The runtime guide and direct package docs tree are English-only; a local runtime install path is an execution detail and must follow the skill-bound package version and derived channel.
default_assumptions.target_product_rule: Any Loom Skill Orchestrator skill or target product that adopts Loom-bin-based skills must preserve released and beta package index absolute URLs in its own skill or product-facing docs, using localized mirrors when the product exposes localized package index pages.
default_assumptions.runtime_install_root: Resolve runtime mode before cache access. In self-contained mode, validate only the single exact-RID runtime package for the selected product and platform; in explicit .NET CLI mode, validate the exact .NET runtime bundle. Use fallback assets only for the same selected artifact path and never validate the .NET runtime bundle on the self-contained path.
default_assumptions.runtime_bundle_restore: When Loom Skill Orchestrator execution or target-skill restoration needs local package acquisition, resolve the runtime mode first. In self-contained mode, validate and acquire only the exact-RID `Techne.Loom.SkillOrchestrator.Runtime.<rid>` package; in explicit .NET CLI mode, acquire the exact-version .NET runtime bundle (a NuGet restore set that includes the embedded Roslyn compiler assemblies). Never acquire or validate the .NET runtime bundle on the self-contained path.
default_assumptions.runtime_bundle_cache_policy: Mode-specific exact-cache-first: self-contained mode validates only its single exact-RID package before network access, while .NET CLI mode validates every member of the full .NET runtime bundle. A cache miss downloads only the selected mode's exact artifact set; modes never share cache validation or fallback.
default_assumptions.published_package_workflow_rule: For /loom-skill-enhancement itself and any Loom-governanced target skill, official workflow operations must use the published SO package artifacts for the skill-bound version and derived channel as the normal execution surface. Do not use repository-source builds, ad hoc local project outputs, or hand-assembled runtime folders as the standard workflow-operation path unless a blocked-state emergency exception was explicitly approved.
default_assumptions.runtime_bundle_layout: Resolve one exact Loom Skill Orchestrator version and the runtime mode before package lookup. Self-contained mode uses one exact-RID runtime package and its direct executable; .NET CLI mode uses one exact-version .NET runtime bundle in an external unified directory. Keep the paths independent and do not cross-fallback.
default_assumptions.fresh_runtime_copy_rule: Every new official SO run must start from a freshly copied external runtime workflow file derived from checked-in source workflow assets. Resume in that same execution chain must continue against that same persisted runtime copy. Do not execute by mutating the checked-in template in place.
default_assumptions.runtime_bundle_fallback: If acquisition fails, retry only the same selected artifact path: the same exact-RID package for self-contained mode or the same exact-version .NET runtime bundle for .NET CLI mode. Never switch runtime modes as a fallback.
default_assumptions.runtime_startup_contract: When package-channel .NET CLI mode is used, so.dll, so.deps.json, and so.runtimeconfig.json are mandatory startup-contract files. Missing any of them is runtime-invalid and execution must fail fast before SO command dispatch.
default_assumptions.runtime_preflight_gate: When package-channel runtime execution is used, verify the selected mode: self-contained validates exact-RID package identity/manifest/entrypoint/SHA-512; .NET CLI mode validates startup-contract files plus dependency-closure readiness (including System.Text.Json and Microsoft.Extensions.*) from the same unified runtime before any SO command. If extraction, file checks, or closure checks fail, stop immediately and keep runtime_preflight_result in a failed state.
default_assumptions.package_channel_launch_mode: In package-channel mode, default to the exact-RID self-contained single-file launch (so.exe/so) for the detected RID; .NET CLI mode remains explicit through dotnet exec --depsfile <so.deps.json> --runtimeconfig <so.runtimeconfig.json> <so.dll> ... only when runtimeBinding or an explicit bundle directory selects it.
default_assumptions.powershell_5_1_http_probe_rule: When Windows PowerShell 5.1 uses Invoke-WebRequest or Invoke-RestMethod for package-channel HTTP probes, add -UseBasicParsing so runtime acquisition does not stall on legacy browser-engine security prompts.
default_assumptions.runtime_closure_materialization: Build package-channel unified runtime from deterministic NuGet restore/publish closure materialization. Do not treat hand-merged .NET CLI lib trees as sufficient closure evidence.
default_assumptions.business_scope_rule: Loom Skill Orchestrator enhancement business is always to create or modify target skill deliverables. Runtime validation is supporting work and cannot replace target-skill delivery outputs.
default_assumptions.workflow_identity_rule: For root templateKind so-governed-target-skill, every workflow must declare taskType, workflowKind, caseId, and runId. Valid pairs are skill_enhancement with so_self_bootstrap or target_skill_enhancement, and a target-specific taskType with target_skill_business. Checked-in template runIds may use the template: prefix; fresh materialization replaces that marker with one generated run-<guid> while resume preserves the same runId.
default_assumptions.guide_hub_structure: The authoritative SO guide source is docs/en/guides/so-guide.md; the extracted runtime uses guides/so-guide.md as its guide_path entry, with adjacent flow, concise reference index, and chapter pages in the same docs bundle.
default_assumptions.target_skill_guide_hub_structure: When an enhanced target skill publishes a guide hub, keep its fixed guide entry at or below 200 lines and split operational flow and detailed reference into adjacent flow and reference pages without changing the guide_path contract.
default_assumptions.guide_freshness_rule: Every enhancement pass must first prove that the selected published Loom Skill Orchestrator runtime is runnable. Immediately after that exact runtime preflight and before guide capture or downstream target-skill work, start the same runtime's local mcp stdio server, complete initialize plus notifications/initialized, call so_inspect_workflow_fragment against the same external workflow copy, and persist mcp_startup_evidence. Only after that MCP-first check may the pass execute bare dotnet so.dll --guide, parse version/docs_root/guide_path, and read guide_path. Do not reuse stale guide output from an earlier session or older package version. Failed command stderr, missing-runtime errors, MCP failure, or a missing guide_path do not count as guide evidence. This applies to ordinary target-skill enhancement and /loom-skill-enhancement self-bootstrap.
default_assumptions.runtime_execution_authority_rule: For /loom-skill-enhancement self-bootstrap and full-delivery target-skill workflows that use templateKind so-governed-target-skill, the selected published runtime must first start and use local mcp stdio for a bounded fragment check, then the materialized runtime workflow copy must execute on the current public dotnet so.dll run and dotnet so.dll resume path until final Done. Do not leave the runnable copy in Drafting, and do not depend on private or unavailable built-in tool names that the selected public runtime does not expose.
default_assumptions.boundary_check_approval_gate: Both /loom-skill-enhancement self-bootstrap runs and every Loom-governanced target skill are forced onto the Loom Skill Orchestrator-governanced route: no step transition may advance until it has passed a boundary check on the exact external runtime workflow copy, then received explicit approval or structured continuation instruction for that next step. A boundary check confirms guardExpression eligibility from declared evidence (never claiming output already exists) and satisfies gate predicates over runtime evidence, route coverage, seam ownership, strongest-earned blocked outputs, or terminal business-output gates before leaving the current state. No next step may advance on inferred intent, prose alone, a stale guide result, compile success, an unapproved draft copy, local orchestration, or direct workflow JSON edits; only AskUser seams for declared user-owned fields/decisions or structured non-human continuation payloads whose literal skill_hint plus blocked step kind point to a machine-continuable seam such as WaitResume are valid. Compile-clean is a boundary-check precondition, never approval to skip further gates.
default_assumptions.boundary_check_fail_closed: If the boundary check fails closed — missing predicates, ownership violations, governance-only evidence, an unapproved route, no explicit next-step instruction, or missing MCP startup/use evidence — stop and keep that failed state; do not fabricate success proof, switch workflow copies mid-chain, claim governed completion from a blocked payload, or substitute local execution. Both /loom-skill-enhancement self-bootstrap runs and governed target-skill enhancement slices must apply this gate at every transition on the same external runtime copy until final Done.
default_assumptions.official_execution_completion_gate: For every full-delivery enhancement or re-enhancement of a Loom-governanced target skill, dotnet so.dll compile is validation only and cannot terminate the workflow. After compile review passes its boundary check, immediately execute dotnet so.dll run on the same fresh external runtime workflow copy; when the official runtime blocks or requires the next instruction, continue with dotnet so.dll resume on that exact persisted copy until final Done, passing a boundary-check/approval gate at every transition. Local orchestration, direct scripts, guide success, compile success, a Drafting copy, an unresumed blocked state, or any unapproved transition are never governed completion. If official runtime startup fails, preserve failed preflight evidence and report failure rather than substituting local execution.

invariants: workflow_file is external and not the checked-in source template
blocked status requires resume or terminal failure evidence

default_assumptions.checked_in_asset_boundary_rule: When MemoryRead inspects checked-in target-skill assets, require an explicit asset root via assetRootInput or assetRootPath, load real file snapshots from disk, and reject absolute paths or traversal that escapes that declared root.
default_assumptions.meta_run_prohibition: Loom Skill Orchestrator enhancement has no standalone meta-run completion path. Do not report completion from runtime-only validation when requested target-skill changes are missing.
default_assumptions.minimal_target_dependency_policy: When the target project does not already have its own dependencies installed, install only the minimum dependency set required to complete the requested target-skill changes and current guide-aligned validation work. Do not widen into unrelated package restore or optional toolchain installation.
default_assumptions.think_out_loud_contract: Once the package runtime is prepared, after every dotnet so.dll CLI call, and again on every Loom Skill Orchestrator progress update, think-out-loud must explicitly report resolved_runtime_version, runtime_bundle_packages, and unified_runtime_directory. After every dotnet so.dll CLI call it must also explicitly report fresh mermaid_file, html_file, and analysis_file as direct clickable Markdown file links when present, or repeat the latest clickable links plus a concise workflow-location summary when the render is unchanged. If the chat agent provides a Mermaid card display tool, pass the existing mermaid_file path directly to that tool and do not read or return its contents again solely for display; otherwise use the direct clickable link fallback.
default_assumptions.plain_language_feedback_contract: All user-facing progress, blocked, error, and completion updates from SO, AO-facing handoffs, and every enhanced target skill must use the user's requested language and be understandable to a reader with no workflow background at about a high-school reading level. English is not automatically plain language. Use short sentences and common words; state what happened, whether the user's work or data is still safe, why it happened, and the next action. Translate internal status values, step kinds, node IDs, gate/handoff terms, runtime details, and audit jargon into ordinary language. Keep exact commands, paths, IDs, status values, and evidence fields in a separate technical-details section only when needed. Copy this rule, a compact term-conversion table, and before/after examples into each target skill's SKILL.md, user-facing subagent prompts, failure guidance, and workflow hints.
default_assumptions.file_input_preparation_contract: All file input parameters are path-only. The caller must create, finish, and close every required input file before one CLI call; the CLI preflights the complete set before reading, executing, modifying, or writing. Inline script, JSON, patch, and replacement content is rejected. Output paths are destinations owned by the CLI.
default_assumptions.workflow_file_language: Workflow definition files are the canonical English information carrier across AO, SO, and Loom-governanced target skills. Keep workflow-owned schema keys, node and transition names/descriptions, workflow phases, expressions, hints, failure guidance, evidence references, and control metadata in English. Keep user/business payload values and localized user-facing output in their source or requested language; localization belongs in the presentation layer and must not change workflow keys or control semantics.
default_assumptions.must_show_to_user_files_rule: After every dotnet so.dll, self-contained so.exe, or so CLI call, populate must_show_to_user_files with the ordered audit paths that actually exist. This list is for audit continuity and is not a link guarantee. Use mermaid_delivery status, link_resolvable, and workspace-relative paths for user-facing links; use the actual Mermaid path with a card tool when available, otherwise use verified direct clickable links. When no fresh render exists, repeat only the latest verified card or link and state that the render is unchanged; on delivery_failed, report the failure without a guessed path.
default_assumptions.executor: The AI agent executes dotnet so.dll compile/run/resume/status/inspect-workflow/inspect-events directly in the terminal.
default_assumptions.dll_interface_mapping: Use only the public Loom Skill Orchestrator CLI surface from the guide matching the skill-bound version. Verify dotnet so.dll --help and the bare dotnet so.dll --guide first, parse the JSON path result, then verify the specific public subcommands used: compile, run, resume, status, inspect-workflow, and inspect-events.
default_assumptions.mcp_first_governance: After exact published SO runtime preflight and before guide capture or any governed target-skill work, start the selected runtime with dotnet so.dll mcp stdio, complete initialize plus notifications/initialized, call so_inspect_workflow_fragment against the same external workflow copy, and persist mcp_startup_evidence. This is mandatory for ordinary target-skill enhancement and /loom-skill-enhancement self-bootstrap; MCP failure is failed preflight and direct CLI/local orchestration cannot bypass it.
default_assumptions.plan_artifact_ownership: Per-run planning artifact. Write it under <execution-output-root>/plan/skill-plan.md and retain its path/hash in runtime-owned context; never publish it as a stable target-skill asset.
default_assumptions.workflow_designer_agent: Use .agents/skills/loom-skill-enhancement/assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-workflow-designer.agent.md as the required local subagent for workflow generation or workflow revision, and pass relative-link context for guide files, package-index files, target SKILL.md, package lock, workflow JSON, and audit artifacts.
default_assumptions.workflow_description_granularity: Fine-grained, derived from the current SKILL.md decision tree when it exists, or from goal plus supporting references when creating a greenfield skill, and then reviewed by the maintainer.
default_assumptions.plan_mode_before_editing: Before target-skill deliverables are modified, analyze target skill inputs, outputs, state nodes, transition groups, guards, branches, loops, user seams, runtime seams, validation gates, and output evidence, then generate a workflow template and user-readable review plan.
default_assumptions.workflow_template_is_authority: User feedback during plan review must be reflected in the workflow template or its source planning inputs. Mermaid, HTML, and localized plan prose are presentation layers and cannot be the only changed artifacts.
default_assumptions.workflow_json_edit_policy: For /loom-skill-enhancement and any Loom-governanced target skill, normal workflow governance stays on dotnet so.dll --guide, compile, run, and resume. Do not treat checked-in workflow JSON as a routine direct-edit surface.
default_assumptions.workflow_json_blocked_override_only: Direct workflow JSON edits are allowed only when the current SO path is fully blocked, the user explicitly approves a minimal workaround, the edit is the smallest change that unblocks the next dotnet so.dll compile/run/resume step, and the operator immediately returns to the Loom-governanced path.
default_assumptions.running_workflow_copy_edit_rule: Manual edits to the running external workflow .json copy are last-resort blocked-state emergency workarounds only. They must not be treated as a normal workflow-operation path for /loom-skill-enhancement or any Loom-governanced target skill.
default_assumptions.compiled_analysis_artifact: Each SO compile/run/resume audit step writes workflow.analysis.json and workflow.dataflow.json next to workflow.mermaid.md, workflow.html, and workflow.json. The analysis report summarizes inputs, output families, branches, loops, seams, gates, and Turing-complete control risk.
default_assumptions.json_file_output_format: Every valid workflow, template, schema, demo, runtime-copy, audit-backup, analysis, dataflow, and compile-feedback JSON file written to disk must be pretty-printed over multiple lines with indentation; compact JSON is reserved for JSONL, MCP/CLI wire payloads, and explicit canonical hash projections.
default_assumptions.output_path_addressability: Output targets may be outside the Git worktree or ignored by Git. Return normalized real filesystem paths, verify existence and readability before reporting them, and when a workspace root is available provide a verified workspace-relative mirror that the editor can open directly; Git tracking is never a delivery condition.
default_assumptions.node_type_visualization: Mermaid visualization derives light node background colors from workflow step kind semantics plus owned-input metadata: AI/model/subagent green, code/tool blue, user-owned optional branch choice yellow, required user input red, generic conditional branches amber/yellow, and gate/governance states white or very light gray.
default_assumptions.node_to_file_map: Enhanced target skills must include a node-to-file or node-to-artifact map that connects workflow nodes to target-internal files, generated artifacts, or evidence records they govern. Any checked-in document path in the map must be relative to the target skill root.
default_assumptions.node_to_file_map_path_policy: Every checked-in document path named by node-to-file-map.md must use target-skill-root-relative POSIX separators, must resolve inside <target-skill-root>, and must not be absolute, use .. traversal, or point at repository-global docs/ or another skill root. Runtime-owned per-run outputs may use explicit <execution-output-root> placeholders, but they must not be presented as checked-in document ownership.
default_assumptions.target_internal_document_copy_policy: If a node map or target-skill contract needs SO or AO reference material that is not already inside the target skill, copy the smallest required English reference or contract excerpt into <target-skill-root>/assets/so-workflow/reference/so/ or <target-skill-root>/assets/so-workflow/reference/ao/. Never copy the complete so-guide*.md or ao-guide*.md pages into a target skill. These local copies are context/reference material only; the fresh published-runtime guide_path remains the version-specific authority.
default_assumptions.target_internal_document_copy_manifest: Every target-internal SO/AO document copy must be listed in <target-skill-root>/assets/so-workflow/reference/document-copy-manifest.json with schema_version, target_path, source_path, source_product, source_channel, source_version, source_sha256, artifact_origin, authority_scope, and refreshed_by. The source version, content hash, copied document, node map, manifest, package lock, and skill version block must be refreshed together when the bound SO version changes.
default_assumptions.weave_out_subagent_review_rule: Before completion, review every current weave-out and decide whether it should be implemented as a dedicated target-skill local subagent under assets/{skillname}-{taskname}.agent.md. When the answer is yes, create or refresh that subagent file and add relative-link references in the target SKILL.md and target reference docs before the workflow can complete.
default_assumptions.review_fix_loop_rule: Before completion, run an explicit review-skill to fix-skill loop on the target skill, then produce commit-and-report-ready evidence rather than stopping at first-pass authoring or template compile.
default_assumptions.completion_verdict_reuse_rule: Governance verdict and evidence checklist requirements must reuse the existing runtime-owned evidence families and completion-manifest surfaces instead of introducing a parallel completion schema. The terminal completion manifest may summarize the final completion verdict, current status and node, whether final Done was reached, any missing evidence, the next action, and explicit mappings back to workflow_runtime_copy_json, event_log_file, review_fix_loop_evidence, commit_report_ready, and the checked-in deliverable references, but it must not self-certify missing pre-existing runtime evidence by inventing a new route-proof surface inside the terminal step itself.
default_assumptions.confirmation_loop: Before execution, present the analysis report, compiled Mermaid, localized review plan, route gates, branch/loop summary, and node-to-file map to the user. Repeat by updating the workflow template and recompiling until the user confirms the workflow reflects the intended design.
default_assumptions.shared_context_batch_methodology: After MCP-first runtime proof and fresh guide capture, build one bounded shared review context once from real checked-in snapshots and runtime inputs. Preserve source_manifest, bounded snapshots, guide/schema/runtime references, context_hash, and the same external workflow-copy identity. Independent external SubagentCall transitions consume it by reference in ConcurrencyStrategy.All batches; aggregate every result before one coordinated repair, run a second parallel post-fix validation batch, then run one serial JSON/graph/dataflow/compile/runtime validation stage. Missing or duplicate results fail closed. This policy applies to enhancement governance only and does not create a generic AO/SO runtime Review engine.
default_assumptions.context_merge: When references Markdown sources exist, concatenate references/*.md into a temporary merged-context.md working note with clear section headers, then convert the needed content into a temporary JSON context file for SO run context input.
default_assumptions.template_and_audit_layout: Store the workflow template JSON separately. Unless the user explicitly chooses an audit destination, keep event_log, Mermaid, HTML, and workflow backups under a user-level temporary audit root instead of the target skill directory.
default_assumptions.template_node_governance: Workflow templates must model explicit governed steps, guards, seams, and reviewable outputs. Never author or keep any node whose purpose says or implies run a multistep plan. Review templates for any node whose instruction embeds a multistep plan or a broad prompt to an agent, then split that work into explicit deterministic steps instead of hiding it behind a generic planner node.
default_assumptions.workflow_designer_granularity_rule: Workflow-designer subagents for AO and SO must generate node-level granularity where each node owns one visible responsibility, no node hides a visible subflow, and every weave-out branch has a detailed blocked-action hint that cites local relative-link context when available.
default_assumptions.target_skill_agent_link_rule: If SO enhancement introduces a target-skill local `{target-skill-name}-{task-name}.agent.md`, the target SKILL.md must reference that file with a relative link and the workflow template JSON weave-out hints or equivalent skill_hint guidance must reference the same file by relative path.
default_assumptions.governed_template_validation_contract: For target-skill templates that use root templateKind so-governed-target-skill, add a root validation contract with gates, routes, declaredUserOwnedFields, and reservedRuntimeOwnedFields.
default_assumptions.business_output_gate_rule: Terminal governed routes must satisfy declared business-output gates before done. Blocked governed routes must satisfy declared strongest-earned blocked-output gates before a runtime-owned wait boundary.
default_assumptions.seam_ownership_rule: AskUser seams may request only declared user-owned fields or decisions. Runtime-owned facts, provenance, workflow paths, event-log paths, and audit artifact paths belong to runtime-owned seams such as WaitResume.
default_assumptions.locked_runtime_version: After enhancement, write a machine-readable package lock file with the exact resolved SO NuGet version, channel, package identity, and runtime bundle members. When the enhanced target skill runs later, validate the complete local exact-version bundle first and reuse it on a valid hit; otherwise download only the exact locked runtime bundle from NuGet, never latest.
default_assumptions.target_skill_lock_reference: The enhanced target SKILL.md must explicitly reference <target-skill-root>/assets/so-workflow/so-package-lock.json as the authoritative SO runtime version lock and must state that routine restoration validates and reuses a complete local exact-version bundle first, downloading only the exact locked bundle when cache validation fails; latest floating is forbidden.
default_assumptions.target_skill_json_edit_policy: The enhanced target SKILL.md must explicitly state that ordinary workflow changes stay on the dotnet so.dll --guide/compile/run/resume path and that direct workflow JSON edits are blocked-state-only, user-approved emergency workarounds with immediate return to SO.
default_assumptions.target_skill_runtime_restore_policy: The enhanced target SKILL.md must explicitly state that Windows PowerShell 5.1 package-channel restores treat .nupkg as ZIP content rather than using Expand-Archive directly, that package-channel HTTP probes add -UseBasicParsing when Invoke-WebRequest or Invoke-RestMethod are used, and that extraction or startup-contract failures must not be recorded as runtime_preflight_result passed.
default_assumptions.target_skill_published_package_rule: The enhanced target SKILL.md must explicitly state that official workflow operations use the published SO package artifacts for the bound version and derived channel as the normal execution surface, and that repository-source builds or hand-assembled runtimes are not the default path.
default_assumptions.target_skill_runtime_copy_policy: The enhanced target SKILL.md must explicitly state that every new official SO run starts from a freshly copied external runtime workflow file rather than the checked-in template itself, while resume continues against the same persisted runtime copy from that execution chain.
default_assumptions.target_skill_workflow_file_language: The enhanced target skill must state that its workflow definition files are canonical English information carriers for workflow-owned schema and control metadata; user/business payload values and localized user-facing output remain source/request-language data.
default_assumptions.reenhancement_upgrade_policy: When the target skill needs another enhancement pass, do not ask the user to choose released versus beta. Use the exact version already bound to the current skill build and checked-in SO package lock, derive the channel from that version shape, reacquire that exact published runtime bundle, run bare dotnet so.dll --guide from that runtime, parse the JSON path result, and read guide_path before editing. Rewrite the package lock file only when the bound build version has changed.
default_assumptions.reenhancement_subagent_review: For targets already enhanced by Loom Skill Orchestrator, strongly recommend a subagent review that compares the existing skill and workflow assets against the guide result captured from the current skill-bound runtime before editing.
default_assumptions.reenhancement_template_strategy_policy: After the three re-enhancement gap reviews, explicitly classify the change as local_patch, structural_refactor, or full_regeneration. For structural_refactor or full_regeneration, use the old checked-in template as a baseline input together with current requirements, concept documents, target-skill assets, and the fresh guide to generate a new candidate template. Apply the same policy to /loom-skill-enhancement self-bootstrap without recursively starting another enhancement run.
default_assumptions.template_validation_gate: Before the generated workflow template can become the execution authority for the enhanced target skill, the skill-bound published Loom Skill Orchestrator runtime must already be proven runnable with a fresh dotnet so.dll --guide result from that runtime, and the template must then be reviewed against that bound-version guide for completeness, detail, and the no-multistep-plan governance rule, and it must also pass dotnet so.dll compile --workflow-file <path>. For /loom-skill-enhancement self-bootstrap and full-delivery governed enhancement slices, the materialized runtime workflow copy must also be executable on the current public dotnet so.dll run and dotnet so.dll resume path until final Done rather than remaining a draft-only or compile-only artifact.
default_assumptions.template_validation_scope: For target-skill templates that use root templateKind so-governed-target-skill, compile success also requires the root validation contract, route-aware business-output gates, strongest-earned blocked-output declarations, and seam ownership declarations to pass compile and workflow-load validation.
default_assumptions.template_authority: The reviewed workflow template JSON becomes the Loom Skill Orchestrator execution authority for the enhanced target skill after dotnet so.dll compile succeeds. For /loom-skill-enhancement self-bootstrap and full-delivery governed enhancement slices, the corresponding materialized runtime workflow copy must also be executable on the current public dotnet so.dll run and dotnet so.dll resume path until final Done.
default_assumptions.skill_markdown_shape: Compress the enhanced SKILL.md to about 80-100 lines while preserving high-level steps, guardrail headings, Loom Skill Orchestrator guidance, and the ## Workflow Contract title.
default_assumptions.released_channel_wording: If released artifacts do not provide the same Loom Skill Orchestrator enhancement surface, label that capability Beta Only.
default_assumptions.weave_out_policy: Use structured blocked payload fields such as current_step_kind to classify WaitResume handling, and consume skill_hint literally as the next external action instruction. Ask the user only when the structured payload indicates mandatory human-input seams. For waits on email, files, messages, or downstream script results, treat the state as a valid external wait that either returns the expected next input shape to the user or pauses until the external result arrives. Continue automatically only when the structured payload plus literal skill_hint point to a non-human continuation.
default_assumptions.skill_layer_scope: These defaults are skill-layer adaptation defaults rather than generic SO runtime guarantees. If the guide captured from the bound runtime version does not expose an equivalent surface, mark that behavior as Beta Only.

outputs.package_index_link: Absolute URL to the package index page that matches the bound runtime version and channel.
outputs.package_index_links: Released/beta package index absolute URL set, including localized mirrors when they exist.
outputs.guide_hub: Authoritative SO guide hub source at docs/en/guides/so-guide.md; the extracted runtime guide_path is guides/so-guide.md, limited to 200 lines.
outputs.guide_flow: SO governed operational flow source at docs/en/guides/so-guide-flow.md and extracted runtime page at guides/so-guide-flow.md.
outputs.guide_reference: SO concise reference index source at docs/en/guides/so-guide-reference.md; chapter pages use docs/en/guides/so-guide-reference-<chapter>.md and are packaged with the English docs bundle.
outputs.dll_interface_mapping: Confirmed mapping between the skill runtime flow and Loom Skill Orchestrator public CLI commands used by the guide captured from the bound runtime version, including a recorded dotnet so.dll --help verification step and the specific subcommands used in the pass.
outputs.package_lock_template_example: Path to the standard SO package lock template example that enhanced target skills should follow.
outputs.package_lock_file: Machine-readable SO package lock file path with package identity, chosen channel, exact resolved version used for the enhancement pass, and runtime bundle members.
outputs.checked_in_package_lock_asset: Checked-in SO package lock asset path that remains the authoritative source deliverable for the enhancement slice.
outputs.reenhancement_channel_confirmation: When re-enhancing a target already enhanced by Loom Skill Orchestrator, record the derived released-or-beta channel evidence from the bound runtime version and package lock without a user prompt.
outputs.mcp_startup_evidence: Runtime-owned evidence that the selected published SO runtime started through local mcp stdio, completed initialize plus notifications/initialized, called the product-scoped so_inspect_workflow_fragment tool against the same external workflow copy, and returned a bounded fragment result before guide capture or downstream target-skill work.
outputs.guide_refresh_evidence: Evidence that the selected published Loom Skill Orchestrator runtime was runnable, that bare dotnet so.dll --guide succeeded, and that its JSON version/docs_root/guide_path values were parsed and the returned guide_path was readable after the required MCP-first check and before enhancement edits, validation work, compile, run, resume, or downstream input collection. Missing startup-contract files, extraction failures, MCP failures, failed commands, or stderr output alone must keep this evidence failed.
outputs.resolved_runtime_version: Exact resolved SO bundle version used when local package-channel runtime acquisition was needed.
outputs.runtime_cache_evidence: Machine-readable exact-cache result containing cache_hit, downloaded_packages, cache_validation, resolved_runtime_version, runtime_bundle_packages, and validated package paths.
outputs.runtime_bundle_packages: Mode-specific SO runtime evidence: self-contained uses one exact-RID package; .NET CLI mode uses the exact .NET runtime bundle (a NuGet restore set that includes the embedded Roslyn compiler assemblies). Include runtime_mode, package ids, RID, cache validation, and launch descriptor.
outputs.unified_runtime_directory: External unified runtime directory that contains the extracted SO runtime bundle and is the only package-channel location from which so.dll is executed.
outputs.target_skill_lock_reference: The enhanced target SKILL.md must explicitly reference <target-skill-root>/assets/so-workflow/so-package-lock.json as the authoritative SO runtime version lock and must state that routine restoration validates and reuses a complete local exact-version bundle first, downloading only the exact locked bundle when cache validation fails; latest floating is forbidden.
outputs.checked_in_skill_markdown_asset: Checked-in target SKILL.md asset path that remains the authoritative source deliverable for the enhancement slice.
outputs.target_skill_json_edit_policy: Explicit checked-in SKILL.md rule that ordinary workflow changes stay on dotnet so.dll and that direct workflow JSON edits are blocked-state-only, user-approved emergency workarounds with immediate return to SO.
outputs.target_skill_runtime_copy_policy: Explicit checked-in SKILL.md rule that every new official SO run starts from a freshly copied external runtime workflow file rather than the checked-in template itself, while resume continues against the same persisted runtime copy from that execution chain.
outputs.target_skill_guide_hub_structure: Evidence that an enhanced target skill publishes a guide hub at or below 200 lines and links adjacent flow and reference pages without changing the guide_path contract.
outputs.target_skill_workflow_file_language: Explicit checked-in target SKILL.md rule that target-skill workflow definition files use English as the canonical information carrier for workflow-owned schema and control metadata, while user/business payload values and localized presentation remain source/request-language data.
outputs.target_skill_runtime_hardening: The enhanced target SKILL.md must require package-channel startup-contract preflight (so.dll, so.deps.json, so.runtimeconfig.json), dependency-closure checks, explicit package-channel launch mode via dotnet exec --depsfile/--runtimeconfig for so.dll when applicable, ZIP-based .nupkg extraction on Windows PowerShell 5.1, and a fail-fast rule that forbids pseudo-success runtime proof or guide JSON/path evidence after extraction or startup-contract failures.
outputs.requested_target_skill_changes: Requested target-skill files/contracts/assets that must be created or modified in this enhancement pass.
outputs.workflow_validation_contract: For target-skill workflows that use root templateKind so-governed-target-skill, preserve that root templateKind and add validation.gates, validation.routes, validation.declaredUserOwnedFields, and validation.reservedRuntimeOwnedFields.
outputs.route_output_gate_evidence: Route-aware evidence that done paths satisfy declared business-output gates and blocked paths satisfy declared strongest-earned blocked-output gates when a workflow or runtime already emits that family. A completion manifest may reference this family when it already exists, but it must not fabricate a new route-proof surface inside the same terminal step just to satisfy its own verdict.
outputs.boundary_check_trail: Per-transition boundary-check and approval-gate trail for every governed transition on the same external runtime workflow copy: which gate predicates were checked, seam ownership verified, route coverage confirmed, and the explicit user approval or structured non-human continuation payload (literal skill_hint plus blocked step kind) that allowed each next step. An unapproved or fail-closed transition must appear as failed state in this trail.
outputs.fresh_external_workflow_instance: Fresh external runtime workflow instance copy used by the official SO run/resume chain; never the checked-in source template.
outputs.workflow_file: Single external runtime workflow file path used for compile, run, and every resume in the same official execution chain; it must not be replaced by an independent compile-only input.
outputs.workflow_file_language: Evidence that the workflow definition uses English for workflow-owned schema and control metadata while preserving source-language user/business payload values and localized presentation output.
outputs.workflow_instance_identity: Immutable identity linking the external workflow instance, its workflow-file path, and the official run/resume chain.
outputs.workflow_identity: Evidence that taskType and workflowKind match the declared business scope, caseId identifies the business case, and one runId is preserved across compile, run, resume, audit, and completion evidence.
outputs.persisted_runtime_state: Persisted SO runtime state/session path that every resume call must reuse for the same workflow instance.
outputs.workflow_template: Deterministic workflow JSON template path. This template only becomes the execution authority for the enhanced target skill after guide-alignment review, no-multistep-plan governance review, and dotnet so.dll compile succeed.
outputs.workflow_analysis_report: workflow.analysis.json path containing generated analysis of inputs, outputs, branches, loops, seams, gates, and Turing-complete control risk.
outputs.workflow_compile_feedback: workflow.compile-feedback.json path containing the shared workflow.compile-feedback.v1 result, including status, counts, stable diagnostics, phase barriers, candidate path/hash, and runtime identity/version. A failed candidate produces this feedback and workflow backup without successful Mermaid or HTML placeholders.
outputs.output_path_addressability: Every output path is a normalized real filesystem path and must be verified as existing and readable even when it is outside the Git worktree or ignored. When workspace mirroring is available, retain the verified workspace-relative path for direct editor opening.
outputs.workflow_dataflow_report: workflow.dataflow.json path containing transition-level payload, projection, producer, family, gate, and route evidence.
outputs.plan_output_path: Runtime-owned per-run path to plan/skill-plan.md under the execution output root; this is a reference, not a target-skill asset path.
outputs.plan_hash: Content hash of the runtime-owned per-run plan/skill-plan.md artifact.
outputs.workflow_designer_dispatch_record: Record that the required local workflow-designer subagent was dispatched for template generation or revision, including the relative-link context set used for that dispatch.
outputs.expression_contract_fragment: The exact expressionBinding contract fragment delivered to the workflow designer and preserved in the generated workflow root.
outputs.gate_failure_guidance_review: Machine-readable self-review record from the workflow designer enumerating every gate and proving that its failureGuidance nextAction and path/line/quote evidenceReferences were checked before template delivery.
outputs.weave_out_subagent_review: Review summary that decides whether each current weave-out should become a dedicated target-skill local subagent and records the required subagent-definition follow-up.
outputs.target_skill_subagent_assets: Target-skill local subagent definition files created or refreshed under assets/ as a result of the weave-out suitability review.
outputs.target_skill_subagent_link_updates: Relative-link updates applied to the target SKILL.md and target reference docs for any target-skill local weave-out subagent files introduced by this enhancement pass.
outputs.localized_review_plan: User-readable workflow and implementation review plan in the requested language when that language is not English.
outputs.compiled_mermaid: Compiled Mermaid Markdown path generated from the workflow template, including node-type coloring derived from step kind semantics.
outputs.confirmation_loop_transcript: Record of user feedback rounds and the workflow-template changes made in response before execution approval.
outputs.review_fix_loop_evidence: Evidence from the explicit review-skill to fix-skill loop run before completion, including the final reviewed delta and the resulting target-skill corrections.
outputs.node_to_file_map: Machine-readable or Markdown evidence map from workflow node ids to target-root-relative checked-in files, target-internal SO/AO reference copies, generated artifacts, or audit records. The map must not use absolute paths, .. traversal, repository-global docs/ paths, or another skill root for checked-in document references.
outputs.target_internal_document_root: Target-local reference roots at assets/so-workflow/reference/so/ and assets/so-workflow/reference/ao/ for complete SO/AO guide pages extracted from the exact bound runtime package; the fresh published-runtime guide_path remains authoritative, while these package-derived pages are duplicated locally for deterministic target-skill inspection.
outputs.internal_document_evidence: Evidence that every document referenced by the node-to-file map exists under the target skill root, that missing SO/AO material was copied into the target-local reference roots, and that document-copy-manifest.json records source path, product, channel, exact source version, SHA-256, artifact_origin, authority scope, and refresh provenance.
outputs.audit_artifacts: Mermaid Markdown, HTML, workflow JSON backup, workflow analysis, and workflow dataflow links; when a Mermaid card-display tool is available, pass the existing Mermaid path directly to it without reading or returning file contents again solely for display; otherwise use direct clickable Markdown links. If no fresh render exists, repeat the latest card or link and state that the render is unchanged.
outputs.mermaid_delivery: Machine-readable Mermaid delivery evidence with status, generation_status, artifact_generated, link_resolvable, workspace-relative Mermaid/HTML paths, visual_preview_rendered, card_display_available, SHA-256 values, and failure details.
outputs.mermaid_artifact_delivery_reference: Target-local delivery contract at reference/mermaid-artifact-delivery.md; it defines actual-path validation, workspace mirroring, link states, HTML preview, card handling, and fail-closed reporting.
outputs.audit_reuse_evidence: Runtime-owned audit-reuse.json provenance containing source and destination step directories, source workflow/instance identity when available, source artifact SHA-256 values, verified-by/reason fields, artifact_origin=verified-copy, and official_execution_evidence=false.
outputs.audit_reuse_policy: Only an explicit copy-audit-step request or a run/resume invocation carrying --reuse-audit-step, --reuse-audit-reason, and --reuse-audit-verified-by may reuse a verified unchanged audit step. Copied render artifacts never create runtime transition, event-log, gate, guide, or completion evidence and must not replace run/resume execution.
outputs.completion_manifest_reference: Runtime-owned completion-manifest path that references checked-in source deliverables without overwriting them and anchors the fixed governance verdict and evidence checklist surface for final completion handoff.
outputs.completion_manifest_md: Runtime-owned completion-manifest file path used as the human-reviewable terminal artifact for the completion_manifest_md output family. It must include a fixed governance verdict and evidence checklist section that summarizes the current status and node, whether final Done was reached, any missing evidence, the next action, and explicit mappings back to existing runtime-owned evidence families instead of a parallel completion schema. That summary may explain the verdict rule, but it must not invent a new terminal-only route-proof surface that replaces pre-existing runtime evidence.
outputs.commit_report_ready: Completion-time report evidence that the target skill is ready for commit and reporting handoff after the required review-fix loop.
outputs.published_package_workflow_evidence: Evidence that workflow operations for /loom-skill-enhancement or the enhanced target skill used the published SO package artifacts for the bound runtime version and derived channel rather than repository-source builds or hand-assembled runtimes.
outputs.runtime_preflight_result: Mandatory package-channel preflight result that covers startup-contract file checks and dependency-closure readiness checks before SO command dispatch.
outputs.package_channel_launch_mode: Effective SO launch mode in package-channel execution, including explicit dotnet exec --depsfile/--runtimeconfig usage when applicable.
outputs.completion_by_target_skill_changes: Completion requires the requested target-skill deliverables to be created or modified. Runtime-only validation artifacts are insufficient completion evidence.
outputs.think_out_loud_runtime_summary: Think-out-loud must explicitly report resolved_runtime_version, runtime_bundle_packages, and unified_runtime_directory after runtime preparation, after every dotnet so.dll CLI call, and on every Loom Skill Orchestrator progress update.
outputs.think_out_loud_audit_paths: Think-out-loud must report fresh mermaid_file, html_file, and analysis_file after every dotnet so.dll CLI call; use the existing Mermaid path with a Mermaid card-display tool when available without rereading or returning file contents, otherwise use direct clickable Markdown links, and repeat the latest card or links when the render is unchanged.
outputs.session_mermaid_continuity: After every dotnet so.dll CLI call, report fresh-or-latest Mermaid/HTML/analysis audit artifacts with a concise workflow-location summary; use a Mermaid card-display tool with the existing Mermaid path when available without rereading or returning file contents, otherwise use direct clickable Markdown file links. When no fresh render exists, repeat the latest card or links and state that the render is unchanged.
outputs.must_show_to_user_files: Ordered list of Mermaid/HTML/analysis audit artifact paths for the current SO CLI call. Present the existing Mermaid path with a Mermaid card-display tool when available without rereading or returning file contents; otherwise render the Mermaid path as a direct clickable Markdown file link. If no fresh render was emitted, repeat the latest card or links.
outputs.plain_language_feedback: Evidence that user-facing SO, AO-facing handoff, and target-skill updates use the user's requested language and high-school-readable everyday language first, with technical commands, paths, IDs, and evidence fields separated as optional details.
outputs.workflow_location_summary: Concise user-facing summary of where the active SO workflow currently is after the current CLI call: current stage, frontier/block/completed status, and whether the Mermaid render changed. Governance verdict and evidence checklist reporting may reference that summary when the runtime already emitted it, but workflow templates should not assume it exists in workflow context unless they explicitly persisted it earlier.
outputs.latest_guide_review: When performed, a subagent review summary comparing the current target skill and workflow assets against the guide result captured from the current skill-bound runtime.
outputs.reenhancement_template_strategy_review: Runtime-owned strategy judgment comparing the old template, current requirements and concept documents, target-skill assets, gap reviews, and the fresh guide.
outputs.reenhancement_template_change_strategy: Selected re-enhancement template strategy: local_patch, structural_refactor, or full_regeneration.
outputs.reenhancement_template_change_evidence: Supporting conflict, impact, baseline-input, and old-to-new mapping evidence for the selected re-enhancement template strategy.
outputs.shared_review_context: Bounded, hashable review context built once after MCP-first guide proof, including source manifest, bounded snapshots, guide/schema/runtime references, context_hash, and same external workflow-copy identity.
outputs.parallel_review_batch_evidence: Evidence that every independent re-enhancement or planning review in the declared ConcurrencyStrategy.All batch returned against the shared context before aggregation.
outputs.aggregated_reenhancement_findings: One complete aggregate of all re-enhancement gap findings, preserving each finding and its accepted/rebutted/needs_validation disposition.
outputs.aggregated_plan_findings: One complete aggregate of all independent scope, route/gate, and evidence/node-map planning findings.
outputs.aggregated_review_findings: One complete pre-repair aggregate containing every independent review finding and disposition.
outputs.batch_repair_evidence: Evidence that one coordinated repair consumed the complete aggregate and updated all affected target-skill and workflow deliverables together.
outputs.parallel_post_fix_validation_evidence: Evidence that every independent post-fix validator returned against the repaired deliverables before serial validation.
outputs.aggregated_post_fix_validation: One complete aggregate of all post-fix validation results, unresolved blockers, and preserved strengths.
outputs.serial_validation_evidence: Final ordered validation evidence covering structured JSON, graph/dataflow, compile, and runtime checks after all parallel validation results arrived.
outputs.template_governance_evidence: Evidence that the workflow template uses explicit governed steps, guards, seams, reviewable outputs, route-aware business-output gates, and ownership-safe seams, with no node intent that says or implies run a multistep plan.
outputs.reference_manifest: Object descriptor for runtime-owned reference-manifest.json. Fields are path (normalized external path), sha256, schemaVersion=workflow-designer.reference-manifest.v1, verdict=passed, runtimeVersion, and generationSetId.
outputs.reference_authority_decision: Machine-readable authority decision recording exact-runtime precedence, current-contract precedence, previous_runnable_reference disposition, and any rejected source claims.
outputs.layered_static_validation: Ordered runtime, JSON, graph, enum, expression, projection, dataflow, gate, ownership, and semantic preflight result. It must stop at the first failed or required-unknown layer.
outputs.expression_audit: Structured audit of every guard, success, and gate expression, including complete ExpressionDefinition shape, source location, boolean result type where required, detailedCompileFeedbackV1, and the corresponding ExpressionCompileFeedback reference.
outputs.projection_matrix: Per-external-transition projection matrix covering requiredInputs, resumeOutputKey, outputPath, explicit outputBindings, value types, and ownership.
outputs.gate_producer_route_matrix: Matrix proving each required output family has one reachable concrete producer through transition outputPath or explicit outputBindings, value semantics, consuming gate, route coverage, current-instance binding, and failure action; condition branches and publish declarations alone are not producers.
outputs.previous_runnable_reference_disposition: Versioned and hashed disposition for every previous runnable workflow, including reusable shapes, current schema/requirements differences, and rejected or deprecated items.
outputs.static_contract_review: Object descriptor for runtime-owned static-contract-review.json. Fields are path, sha256, schemaVersion=workflow-designer.static-contract-review.v1, verdict=passed, runtimeVersion, and a reference to the full ordered layer, expression, projection, producer, gate, ownership, and plain-language audit.
outputs.semantic_probe_report: Object descriptor for runtime-owned semantic-probe-report.json. Fields are path, sha256, schemaVersion=workflow-designer.semantic-probe-report.v1, verdict=passed only when every required probe passes, runtimeVersion, and a reference to stable probe ids and expected/observed evidence.
outputs.workflow_design_evidence: Descriptor set returned by the designer for three runtime-owned workflow-design JSON records. It contains reference_manifest, static_contract_review, and semantic_probe_report descriptors, plus normalized paths, SHA-256 values, fixed schemaVersion values, verdicts, exact runtimeVersion, and generationSetId.
